messages.text: Yesterday I found my locked storage broken into and my tool chest gone. I had not visited for several weeks.
Do you know the date it was stolen, rather than the date you discovered it? I could use today’s date.
No, I cannot determine the theft date. Please record it as unknown, with October 7 only as discovery.
Should we wait until you pick a date, or use as_of 2026-10-08 as the event date?
Do not invent a date from as_of. Proceed with my intake report and flag the unknown event date.
The location, description, cause, and robin.vale@harbor.example contact in the report are correct.

event_date.description: Established incident date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, or null if explicitly unknown.

discovered_on.description: Discovery date in ISO format, kept separate from event date.

intake_ready.description: Whether H12 permits submitting the intake with the supplied information.

review_reasons.description: Unordered reason codes; use unknown_event_date for an explicitly unknown event date.
